title: Metz/Quotes
summary:
"Dante, your first priority must always be to fight evil."
-Metz to Dante Vale (The Vampire Loses Its Fangs)

"I'm glad to finally meet your team."
-Metz to Dante Vale (Ladies' Choice)

"The Huntik Foundation can't let an enemy spy go, so we won't. We'll make you a member, an official Foundation operative."
-Metz to Zhalia Moon (Ladies' Choice)
